chapters.title: The chief of sinners
chapters.summary: Paul urges Timothy to oppose false teaching in Ephesus. Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom Paul says he is the chief, yet he received mercy.

chapters.title: Prayer for all
chapters.summary: Pray for all people, including rulers. There is one God and one mediator between God and humanity, the man Christ Jesus.

chapters.title: Leaders in the church
chapters.summary: The qualities required of overseers and deacons. Great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh.

chapters.title: An example to believers
chapters.summary: Some will depart from the faith. Train yourself in godliness. Let no one despise your youth, but be an example in word, conduct, love, faith and purity.

chapters.title: Caring for the church family
chapters.summary: Treat older men as fathers and younger women as sisters. Care for widows in need, and honor elders who lead well.

chapters.title: Godliness with contentment
chapters.summary: Godliness with contentment is great gain; the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Fight the good fight of faith.
